test_copy_index_name_checking: test the DataFrame.copy method does not share index or column name references with the original
test_copy_isolation: test the DataFrame.copy method creates an independent copy with a separate internal manager
test_copy_new_column: test adding a new column to a DataFrame copy does not affect the original DataFrame
test_copy_consolidates: test the DataFrame.copy method consolidates multiple blocks into a single block
test_copy_no_side_effects: test modifying index or column names on a copy does not affect the original DataFrame
